findings.evidence: Mathlib declares `Finsupp.smul_single_one` with `[MulZeroOneClass R]`, `Finsupp.sum_single` with `[AddCommMonoid M]`, and `Finsupp.single_zero` with only `[Zero M]`; the corresponding wrapper proofs merely invoke these lemmas.
findings.fix: Keep `instModule` under `[Semiring R]`, but state `smul_single_one` under `[MulZeroOneClass R]`, `sum_single`/`single_add`/`induction_linear` under `[AddCommMonoid R]`, and `single_zero` under `[Zero R]`.
findings.issue: The section-wide `[Semiring R]` over-specializes `smul_single_one`, `sum_single`, `single_zero`, `single_add`, and `induction_linear`; only `instModule` inherently needs `Semiring`.

summary: Several basis-element lemmas are unnecessarily restricted to semiring coefficients despite their underlying Finsupp results requiring substantially weaker structures.
